name: Management interfaces (RDP, SSH, SMB, SQL) MUST NOT be exposed directly to the public internet because this is the fastest way to suffer a critical ransomware event.
conditionsText: Services that utilise RDP, SSH, SMB or SQL and similar
requirementTitle: Management interfaces (RDP, SSH, SMB, SQL) MUST NOT be exposed directly to the public internet because this is the fastest way to suffer a critical ransomware event.
requirementDescription: Do not allow administrative access to systems directly from the internet. Management services such as RDP, SSH, SMB, and SQL should only be accessible through secure, controlled routes
why: Attackers constantly scan the internet looking for exposed management services. Administrative services should never be directly reachable from the internet. They must be protected behind secure access mechanisms
